frontend.runtime_model: prebuilt static SPA assets served by the local Python application; installed SOMA requires no Node.js runtime

dependency_policy.router_library: none; closed SOMA route registry over browser History API
dependency_policy.global_state_library: none; small SOMA stores use React primitives/useSyncExternalStore
dependency_policy.css_in_js: none; semantic CSS custom properties and ordinary stylesheets
dependency_policy.virtualization_library: none in Beta 1.0; bounded keyset pages prevent unbounded DOM lists

browser_host_rule: LLD-12 packaging may choose the exact supported Windows browser/WebView host, but it must satisfy all required web-platform features; LLD-10 does not weaken interactions for a host missing them.
security_rules: all API requests same-origin to loopback application boundary
Content-Security-Policy is finalized by LLD-12 but LLD-10 uses no design that requires unsafe-eval
